## Summary

Describe what changed.

## Why this change matters

Explain the problem this solves or the value it adds.

## Review notes

Call out anything reviewers should pay special attention to.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused on one topic or correction.
- [ ] The wording is clear and accessible.
- [ ] Relevant examples, references, or context are included when helpful.
- [ ] Links and Markdown formatting have been checked.
